name: Cubing ATMOSphere 2022
information: All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except the New comers) will be assigned to a particular event that they have to Judge (or) Scramble in which they are participating. All the staff/volunteering assignments will be decided by the organising team and participants will be informed of the same 2 days prior to the event, we will ensure that your volunteering does not affect your events. Please check out all the tabs for additional important information. COVID-19 Specific Information: * Wearing masks, Sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment orders is mandatory while attending the competition. **Only Participants are allowed inside the solving area/room.** Parents, relatives and friends will strictly not be allowed inside of the solving area. There will be a seprate waiting area/room for all accompanying guests.
